market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. S&P 500 in 4th straight decline; oil at $105 and yields at multi-year highs create stagflationary pressure. Oracle earnings and continued Iran conflict are key swing factors. Expect volatility 15-20% ATR. Fed hike bets rising; ECB already hiked twice. Trade war with Canada adds noise. 1-3 months: range-bound to lower, with oil as primary driver.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilizes below $110 and AI capex translates to revenue. Defense, AI infrastructure, and healthcare offer secular growth. Split Congress likely moderates fiscal risk. 6-12 months: recovery likely if Iran conflict de-escalates and inflation cools; otherwise stagflation persists. Key inflection: Oracle earnings, Fed decision, Hormuz flow normalization.
